subject: Velotech vendor onboarding — bank proof and remittance layout
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@velotech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: bank proof + remit format (Velotech)

Hi Laura,

Thanks for starting the onboarding process with Redwood — excited to get Velotech set up. Finance has a couple of checks to complete before we can issue POs and schedule the first payment. Can you send the following items so we can finish vendor activation?

1) Tax paperwork: current W-9 (signed) or equivalent tax form.
2) Bank evidence: a bank letter on bank letterhead OR a voided check showing company name + routing/account.
3) Preferred remittance layout: how you prefer remittance details to be delivered (single-line text, structured CSV, EDI). If you have a sample ACH/Wire flat file spec for incoming payments, please attach.
4) Banking routing details (routing number & account number) — if you prefer, send a bank letter and include the last 4 of the account in email for verification; we do not store full PAN in email.

Two quick clarifications we need from you: do you accept consolidated remittance files (i.e., multiple invoice remits in a single CSV), and do you require a specific PO token in the remittance reference (e.g., PO-12345)?

I've attached a small Redwood remit mapping template to show our preferred CSV columns: [Attachment: redwood_remit_template.csv]. Please fill if possible.

If you can send the items by end of week (EOD Fri), we can aim to have POs created next week and target a first payment the following week.

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@velotech.com>

Date: 2027-09-02T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: bank proof + remit format (Velotech)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks — attaching what we have so far.

Attachments: Velotech_W9.pdf (signed), Velotech_bank_letter.pdf (bank letter confirming account and routing)

We can accept consolidated remittance CSVs. Our preferred remittance reference is VEL-PO-<PO_NUMBER> but we can also accept Redwood's PO token if you include it in the invoice line.

For ACH micro-deposits: we typically expect a micro-deposit verification to be completed before initiating the first ACH. If Redwood prefers a wire for the first payment, we can provide SWIFT/BIC details — let me know.

Notes: our internal finance team uses invoice labels like VEL-INV-<YYYYMM>-<SEQ>. For the CSV, we can map the fields you send; attached is a simple spec of the fields we accept (column names).

We'll plan to send the micro-deposit on our side once you confirm the exact account last-4 we expect to see (for security).

Best,
Laura Chen
Director of Finance Operations
Velotech Labs
laura.chen@velotech.com

Date: 2027-09-03T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: bank proof + remit format (Velotech)

Hi Laura,

Received — thank you for the W-9 and bank letter. A few items to help Finance map things on our side:

- Redwood remit CSV preferred columns (example): remit_id, vendor_name, invoice_number, po_number, invoice_date, invoice_amount, currency, remit_notes
- Remit reference string we push on the payment: "redwood|VEL|{po_number}|{invoice_number}|{amount}" — if you can accept that in the remittance_ref column we'll link payments to invoices automatically.
- For PO handling: our procurement system requires the vendor EIN (or TAX ID) to generate the PO and create a valid routing. If you can provide EIN in reply that would unblock PO issuance.

I've uploaded an example CSV to our shared Drive and linked it below for your team to review. If you prefer us to ingest your CSV directly, we can accept the column names in your spec — just confirm exact header names.

Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-example-remit-template

Thanks — Jordan from our Purchasing team will create the PO once we have the EIN and a confirmation of the last 4 on the bank account for verification.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Soojin

Hi Laura — looping in Purchasing next steps.

We need the following to generate a PO and finalize vendor in AP:
- Vendor legal name and EIN (exact as on the W-9)
- Confirmation of last 4 digits of the ACH account on the bank letter you provided (so we can match)
- If the first payment will be a wire, please include SWIFT/BIC and the beneficiary name format exactly as bank requires.

Once we have EIN + last 4 we will:
1) Create vendor record and issue PO(s) (will send as PDF).
2) Confirm remittance ingestion mapping with Finance (Priyom will own acceptance test).

If you prefer, we can send a DocuSign link for the W-9 instead of the signed PDF — let me know.

Thanks — Jordan
